title: Shani dhaiya: the 2.5 year Saturn transit that is not sade sati | Ask Tota
description: Dhaiya is Saturn in the 4th or 8th from your Moon, for about 30 months. Here is kantaka shani, ashtama shani, where they sit in the 29.5 year cycle, and how they differ from sade sati.
og_title: Shani dhaiya, the other Saturn transit
og_description: Two and a half years in the 4th or the 8th from your Moon, twice per Saturn cycle. Not sade sati, and not a separate doctrine either.
h1: shani dhaiya is two and a half years, and it is not sade sati
dek: dhai means two and a half. dhaiya is saturn crossing the 4th or the 8th from ur moon sign, twice in every saturn cycle, and it is the reason people who are definitively not in sade sati still get told shani is on them.
card_title: shani dhaiya is two and a half years, and it is not sade sati
card_dek: saturn in the 4th or the 8th from ur moon, about thirty months, twice per cycle. kantaka, ashtama, and where both sit in the 29.5 years.
llms_desc: the 2.5 year Saturn transit of the 4th house (kantaka shani) and the 8th house (ashtama shani) from the natal Moon, where both sit in the 29.5 year Saturn cycle, and how they differ from sade sati.

faq.a: the two and a half years when transiting saturn is in the 4th or the 8th house counted from ur natal moon sign. dhai means two and a half, which is how long saturn takes to cross one sign.
find ur moon sign, count to the 4th and the 8th sign from it, and check whether saturn is currently in either. that is the whole calculation and it needs only ur moon sign.

faq.q: what is the difference between kantaka shani and ashtama shani?
faq.a: kantaka shani is the 4th house version and kantaka means thorn. ashtama shani is the 8th house version and ashtama just means eighth. both last about thirty months.

faq.q: how often does shani dhaiya happen?
faq.a: each one comes round once per saturn cycle, so about every 29 and a half years, and there are two of them. across a long life u would meet each one two or three times.

faq.q: is shani dhaiya worse than sade sati?
faq.a: it is shorter. sade sati is seven and a half years across three houses and a dhaiya is two and a half in one. ashtama shani is usually treated as the harder of the two dhaiyas.

faq.q: can i be in sade sati and shani dhaiya at the same time?
faq.a: no. they are different houses from ur moon and saturn occupies one sign at a time. u can leave one and reach the other within a couple of years, which is where the feeling of a long saturn stretch comes from.
the 4th from the natal moon. the 4th covers home, land, the domestic base and peace of mind, so the transit is read as pressure on the place u rest rather than on the work u do.

faq.q: is shani dhaiya counted from the moon or the lagna?
faq.a: classical gochar counts from the moon. some practitioners also read it from the lagna and weight the case where both agree, which is a reasonable modern refinement rather than the classical rule.

faq.q: does everyone with my moon sign have shani dhaiya at the same time?
faq.a: yes, which is about a twelfth of everyone alive. what separates ur version from theirs is the ashtakavarga bindu count in that sign, the vedha rule, and which dasha u are running.

faq.q: what are the remedies for shani dhaiya?
faq.a: the traditional prescriptions are observances: saturday fasting, feeding people, donating black sesame or iron, and the shani mantras. they are practices rather than purchases, and the transit ends on schedule regardless.

faq.q: how long does shani dhaiya last exactly?
faq.a: about thirty months, the time saturn takes to cross one sign. saturn's retrograde loops can make the boundaries messy, so the start and end can wobble by a few weeks either side.

faq.q: does shani dhaiya affect marriage or career specifically?
faq.a: only through the house it is in. the 4th is home and peace of mind, the 8th is transitions and things not under ur control. specific life areas come from ur own chart and the dasha running, not from the dhaiya label.
